arguments:
{"args":["-lc","python3 << 'PY'
import chess
import chess.engine
fen = open('/app/position.fen').read().strip()
print(f"FEN: {fen}")
board = chess.Board(fen)
print(board)
print(f"Turn: {'White' if board.turn else 'Black'}")
print(f"Legal moves: {list(board.legal_moves)[:10]} ... total {len(list(board.legal_moves))}")
with chess.engine.SimpleEngine.popen_uci('/usr/games/stockfish') as engine:
    result = engine.play(board, chess.engine.Limit(depth=15))
    move = result.move
    print(f"Best UCI: {move.uci()}")
    print(f"From: {chess.square_name(move.from_square)}, To: {chess.square_name(move.to_square)}")
    san = board.san(move)
    print(f"SAN: {san}")
    print(f"Line: {chess.square_name(move.from_square)} {chess.square_name(move.to_square)} {san}")
    # legality check
    print(f"Legal: {move in board.legal_moves}")
    # also show info
    info = engine.analyse(board, chess.engine.Limit(depth=15))
    print(f"Score: {info['score']}")
PY"],"command":"bash","timeout_ms":120000}

move=chess.Move.from_uci(frm+to)

assert move in board.legal_moves, 'illegal move!'
assert board.san(move)==san, 'SAN mismatch!'
print('OK: legal and SAN matches')
